headline: Flat margins, lower profit; year EBITDA near low end
summary_short: Total Segment Margin was $147.2M, roughly flat y/y, while net income fell to $2.4M from $9.2M. Management says full-year Adjusted EBITDA will likely land near or below the low end of guidance.
summary_long: Offshore pipeline margin fell 4% on producer downtime and weak Shenandoah well performance, leaving volumes below the minimum volume commitment. Marine margin rose 12% on higher utilization and day rates; onshore margin rose 5% on volumes. Net income was hit by $3.9M higher depreciation and $3.1M higher G&A. Distribution coverage was 1.58X on a $0.20 quarterly common distribution. No borrowings are outstanding on the $900M facility; bank leverage is 5.03X.
confidence_notes: Adjusted EBITDA, Available Cash before Reserves and Segment Margin are non-GAAP. Revenue y/y and net income y/y use the release (net income) and shard values (revenue, SEC XBRL / Yahoo timeseries).

drivers.explanation: Offshore pipeline decline from producer downtime and Shenandoah underperformance was nearly offset by gains in marine and onshore segments.
Higher depreciation and amortization expense of $3.9M and higher general and administrative expense of $3.1M weighed on net income.

Management cites Hurricane-related disruption in October, curtailed legacy production and lower expected deepwater volumes, putting full-year Adjusted EBITDA near or below the low end of original guidance.
